sample_unit: synthetic EHR patient message scenarios with LLM drafts

links.outcome: Physician-rated acceptability and harm potential of LLM drafts when reviewed before sending
links.effect: Physicians rated LLM-assisted responses acceptable without modifications in 58/80 (72.50%); unedited drafts had low chance of harm in 75/80 (93.75%), so 22/80 needed edits before being safe to send.
links.quote: In stage 2, the physicians rated the LLM-assisted responses as acceptable without modifications in 58 out of 80 cases (72.50%).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates orthopaedic surgeons reviewing and editing ChatGPT-4 drafted EHR patient messages to determine clinical acceptability and safety.

primary.practice: clinician review and editing of drafted messages
